description: MiniQMT observability/contract gap: backend/services/simulation_runtime/scheduler.py:4661 (and post-close :2300) allow a run to return top-level SUCCEEDED when there is a terminal_capacity_residual (reason miniqmt_capacity_residual_skipped_and_reconciled). Example: today's L16 run returned SUCCEEDED while failed_intents=28. The residual handling is BY DESIGN (funds-only capacity skip + reconcile, not a run-correctness bug), but monitoring/acceptance that reads only the top-level SUCCEEDED gets a false-positive ('looks successful, actually many intents unexecuted'). FIX (observability only): expose an explicit succeeded_with_capacity_residual flag + residual/failed_intents count in (a) the run summary/result and API payload, (b) the live dashboard / performance report, (c) an alert/telemetry signal, so monitoring distinguishes clean SUCCEEDED from SUCCEEDED-with-capacity-residual. No silent masking; do not change the run's actual terminal decision. MiniQMT-scoped; LocalSim untouched.
